questions.description: 用 for 输出 1 到 5。
questions.code_template:
for i in range(1, 6):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for i in range(1, 6):
    print(i)

questions.description: 用 for 输出 0 到 4。
questions.code_template:
for i in range(5):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for i in range(5):
    print(i)

questions.code_template:
for i in range(0, 7, 2):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for i in range(0, 7, 2):
    print(i)

questions.description: 遍历列表逐行输出。
questions.code_template:
for fruit in ["apple", "banana"]:
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for fruit in ["apple", "banana"]:
    print(fruit)

questions.description: 遍历字符串逐字符输出。
questions.code_template:
for ch in "Hi":
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for ch in "Hi":
    print(ch)

questions.description: 遍历字典的键。
用倒序 range 输出 3、2、1。
questions.code_template:
for i in range(3, 0, -1):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for i in range(3, 0, -1):
    print(i)

questions.description: 用循环累加 1 到 5。
questions.code_template:
total = 0
for i in range(1, 6):
    total += i
print(___)
questions.solution:
total = 0
for i in range(1, 6):
    total += i
print(total)

questions.description: 用循环累乘 1 到 4。
questions.code_template:
product = 1
for i in range(1, 5):
    product *= i
print(___)
questions.solution:
product = 1
for i in range(1, 5):
    product *= i
print(product)

questions.description: 用循环计数 1 到 5 的个数。
questions.code_template:
count = 0
for i in range(1, 6):
    count += 1
print(___)
questions.solution:
count = 0
for i in range(1, 6):
    count += 1
print(count)

questions.description: 用 enumerate 输出索引和值。
questions.code_template:
for i, v in enumerate(["a", "b"]):
    print(___, v)
questions.solution:
for i, v in enumerate(["a", "b"]):
    print(i, v)

questions.description: 循环中遇到 3 用 break 退出。
循环中用 continue 跳过 3。
for 循环正常结束后执行 else。
嵌套循环输出乘法表一列。
用 zip 并行遍历两个列表。
questions.code_template:
for a, b in zip([1, 2], [3, 4]):
    print(___, b)
questions.solution:
for a, b in zip([1, 2], [3, 4]):
    print(a, b)

questions.description: 用列表推导式生成平方。
questions.code_template:
squares = [n * n for n in range(1, 4)]
print(___)
questions.solution:
squares = [n * n for n in range(1, 4)]
print(squares)

questions.description: 遍历元组输出。
questions.code_template:
for v in (10, 20):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for v in (10, 20):
    print(v)

questions.description: 遍历排序后的集合。
questions.code_template:
for v in sorted({3, 1, 2}):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for v in sorted({3, 1, 2}):
    print(v)

questions.description: 循环拼接字符串。
questions.code_template:
result = ""
for ch in "abc":
    result += ch
print(___)
questions.solution:
result = ""
for ch in "abc":
    result += ch
print(result)

questions.description: 输出 1 到 4 的平方。
questions.code_template:
for i in range(1, 5):
    print(___ * i)
questions.solution:
for i in range(1, 5):
    print(i * i)

questions.description: 输出 1 到 10 中的偶数。
输出 1 到 10 中的奇数。
累加 1 到 10 中的偶数。
循环变量参与运算。
questions.code_template:
for i in range(1, 4):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for i in range(1, 4):
    print(i + 10)

questions.description: 用三参数 range 输出 5、4、3。
questions.code_template:
for i in range(5, 2, -1):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for i in range(5, 2, -1):
    print(i)

questions.description: 循环结束后输出总数。
解包遍历二维列表。
questions.solution:
for a, b in [[1, 2], [3, 4]]:
    print(a + b)

questions.description: 用 reversed 逆序输出。
questions.code_template:
for v in reversed([1, 2, 3, 4]):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for v in reversed([1, 2, 3, 4]):
    print(v)

questions.description: 输出 3 次问候。
questions.code_template:
for i in range(3):
    print(___)
questions.solution:
for i in range(3):
    print("Hi")
